author: Wahiz
body:
Ok, so I got this idea from a youtuber known as TouchToDisplay, were he basically will 1v1 people to find good pot pvpers and he will record wins and losses. So I was thinking hey why not just do it for me, and do it for my entire team.

1v1s will happen every Saturday (You Pick The Time (or) Talk To The Person You Want To 1v1) all 1v1s will be No Debuff on Badlion or Kohi potpvp.

If you want to do it, reply with a time that would be good for you (convert it to EST) and pick who you want to 1v1 from our roster.

Cheers!
